# The Roy Effect

> Independent brand, web design, UI/UX and no-code build studio run by
> Rory Ulloa, a creative director based in Houston, Texas. Works solo with
> owner-run businesses, founders and service companies, from first audit
> through the finished build.

## Services and starting prices
- Brand Sprint, from $2,500: brand strategy workshop, logo system, color and type, basic guidelines
- Website / UI-UX, from $5,000: full visual design and clickable prototype
- Design + Build, from $8,000: end-to-end design plus a production no-code build (Webflow, Framer or TanStack)
- Design Retainer, $3,000/month: ongoing creative direction and UI/UX
- Deposits are 50% of the tier's starting price and are credited against the final invoice

## Free website audit
A personal video teardown of a site's conversion, mobile experience and
brand positioning, for Houston small businesses.
https://theroyeffect.com/audit
